__broaden__.δώρων: δῶρον — gift; neut. gen. pl., partitive with κειμήλια: ’of the gifts’ · also gen. pl. after εἵνεκα: ’of gifts’ (γυναίων εἵνεκα δώρων ’on account of women’s gifts’)
__broaden__.θῦε: θύω (B) — rush, surge, rage; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθυε); distinct from θύω ’sacrifice’ · also θύω (A) — sacrifice; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθυε), + dat. of the god: ’sacrificed’ (θῦε δ’ Ἀθήνῃ ’and sacrificed to Athena’)
__broaden__.οἷος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg. · rough-breathed οἷος is relative ’such as, of the kind that’ (οἷος Ὀδυσσεὺς ἔσκεν ’such as Odysseus was’) · also οἷος in an indirect exclamation, ’what sort of’ (οἷος κείνου θυμός ’what sort his spirit is’)
__broaden__.πέλας: πέλας — near, close by; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’near’ (Τηλεμάχου πέλας ’near Telemachus’)
__broaden__.πατρὶ: πατήρ — father; masc. dat. sg., governed by ὁμοῖοι ’like’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the person told: ’to (her) father’ (ἀγγείλειε ... πατρὶ φίλῳ ’report to her dear father’) · also masc. dat. sg. in apposition to Zeus: Διὶ πατρὶ ’to father Zeus’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the god prayed to: εὔχεο πατρὶ Ποσειδάωνι ’pray to your father Poseidon’ · also masc. dat. sg. after παρά: ’beside (their) father’ (παρὰ πατρὶ φίλῳ) · also masc. dat. sg. object of χαριζόμενος: ’pleasing (his own) father’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the person one is angry at: πατρὶ χολωθείς ’angered at his father’
__broaden__.σπουδῇ: σπουδή — haste, effort, zeal; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ‘with effort, barely’ · also fem. dat. sg. adverbial, ’in haste, hurriedly’ (σπουδῇ νῦν ἀνάβαινε ’now go aboard in haste’)
__broaden__.τελέσειεν: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may he bring to pass’ · also potential (with κεν): ’might bring to pass’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in an indirect question after a past verb: ’how he might fulfil’ (ὅππως … τελέσειεν)
__broaden__.φιλέειν: φιλέω — love, be fond of; pres. inf., uncontracted (= Attic φιλεῖν) · also ’treat as a guest, welcome’ (ἱέμενος φιλέειν ’eager to welcome’)
__broaden__.χρεὼ: χρεώ — need, necessity; fem. nom. sg. __broaden__.ἔκγονος: ἔκγονος — offspring, descendant; fem. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.), predicate: ’born of’ · also masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’descendant (of Melampus)’
